mods.name: Matter Network
mods.description: An end-game storage solution mod. Build a digital storage network with a central controller, expandable disk drives, and access interfaces your pawns can use across the base. Replace massive stockpiles with sleek, shared storage that grows with your colony. Perfect for advanced, high-tech colonies.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Matter Network

mods.name: UI Soundpacks
mods.description: Adds a collection of custom UI soundpacks, letting you change the feel of Rimworld's interface with entirely different audio themes. The mod currently offers 3 different soundpacks.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for UI Soundpacks

mods.name: Stockpile It!
mods.description: Right-click any item on the map to add it straight to a stockpile or storage building's filter.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Stockpile It!

mods.name: Raiders Inherit
mods.description: Replaces the vanilla "Man in Black" recovery event with something a bit more fitting: when your colony's last colonist falls to an enemy raid, you inherit the raid itself instead of a lone stranger wandering in. A configurable number of the surviving raiders join your colony immediately; the rest are released as non-hostile allies and leave the map peacefully, so nobody is left behind to turn around and attack your new colonists.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Raiders Inherit

mods.name: Research Requires Resources
mods.description: Research Requires Resources makes research a tangible colony investment. Projects with material costs need a one-time funding bundle before research can begin. When you select one, colonists automatically deliver the required resources to a research bench; the Research tab shows delivery progress, reserved items, and funding status. Once the bundle is paid, the project uses vanilla research points as normal.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Research Requires Resources

mods.name: VFE Tribals Auto Gathering
mods.description: Adds daily automation for Vanilla Factions Expanded - Tribals' tribal gathering research ritual. Right-click the tribal gathering gizmo at an active gathering spot to schedule it to begin automatically at that same local time each day. Right-click it again to disable the schedule.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for VFE Tribals Auto Gathering

mods.name: Building Alternatives Framework
mods.description: A lightweight, customizable framework that enables modders to group alternative building variants under a single designator dropdown, keeping your Architect Menu clean, organized, and clutter-free.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Building Alternatives Framework

mods.name: Hide Unloaded Mods Errors
mods.description: Suppresses Rimworld's startup warnings and errors that are produced only while Rimworld inspects an installed mod that is not enabled in your mod list (invalid dependency metadata, malformed About.xml). Messages from enabled mods, Core, and DLC are never touched. Requires Prepatcher.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Hide Unloaded Mods Errors

mods.name: Windows XP UI SFX
mods.description: Bring the familiar sounds of Windows XP to Rimworld's interface, from startup and shutdown chimes to menu clicks, alerts, and more. This mod is a demo showcase for Soundpacks Framework.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Windows XP UI SFX

mods.name: Soundpacks Framework
mods.description:
Replace Rimworld’s sound effects with custom, shareable soundpacks.
Soundpacks Framework lets players import a soundpack, choose it in-game, and replace individual vanilla or mod-added SoundDefs with their own MP3, WAV, or OGG audio. It is a framework: this mod does not include a replacement soundpack by itself.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Soundpacks Framework

mods.name: Lumen Control
mods.description: Adds a gizmo to adjust a light source's glow radius. Works for all light sources.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Lumen Control

mods.name: Quick Mod Settings
mods.description: Adds a button to the bottom bar that opens a list of every installed mod with settings. Pick a mod to edit its settings directly, without pausing the game or digging through the vanilla Options menu.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Quick Mod Settings

mods.name: Dont Leave it Behind
mods.description: Warns you before leaving a non-home map if valuable items would be left behind. Applies to caravans, shuttles, and gravships, with a configurable minimum item value. Cancel to stay, or confirm to leave anyway.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Dont Leave it Behind

mods.name: Gravship Raids
mods.description: Adds gravship raids into the game.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Gravship Raids

mods.name: Mod of the Day
mods.description: Displays a random trending mod from Steam Workshop in the main menu.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Mod of the Day

mods.name: Trader Will Buy Search
mods.description: Adds a search bar to the trader will buy menu.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Trader Will Buy Search

mods.name: Chargeable Bionics
mods.description:
Gives all vanilla bionics implants a charge bar that drains over time.
When a bionic runs out of charge, it loses efficiency, body part bionics drop in part effectiveness and stat-boosting implants lose their bonuses. Recharge colonists at the Bionic Charge Station (requires Bionics research).

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Chargeable Bionics

mods.name: Chargeable Hediffs Framework
mods.description: A framework for modders that gives any hediff an independent electrical charge store.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Chargeable Hediffs Framework

mods.name: Message Customizer
mods.description: Customize Rimworld's top-left messages. Change font size, text color, stroke, background, and border.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Message Customizer

mods.name: VFE Tribals Cornerstone Search
mods.description: Adds a searchbar to the cornerstone menu.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for VFE Tribals Cornerstone Search

mods.name: Music Manager Search
mods.description: Adds a search bar to music manager's UI.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Music Manager Search

mods.name: Workshop Mod Tags
mods.description:
Adds support for Workshop-style custom tags to help Rimworld mods describe what they add, change, or depend on. The goal is to make browsing, sorting, and organizing mods easier by encouraging authors to use clearer, more consistent tags.

This mod does not add official Rimworld Workshop filter categories in Steam's backend. It also cannot guarantee that Steam displays any custom tag, since Steam controls how tags appear on Workshop pages.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Workshop Mod Tags

mods.name: Mixed Manhunter Attacks
mods.description: Adds a chance for a manhunter events to spawn with a mixed group of animals. A settings menu is available to configure the % chance of a mixed attack.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Mixed Manhunter Attacks

mods.name: Pawn Perspective
mods.description: Allows rotating pawns during the pawn generation screen before starting a game.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Pawn Perspective

mods.name: Keybindings Search
mods.description: Adds a search bar to the keybindings option window.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Keybindings Search

mods.name: Sweet Victory
mods.description: Plays the mech cluster defeated sound effect when a raid or an insect hive is defeated. Also, adds a mood buff for defeating raids.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Sweet Victory

mods.name: Closer VE Quests
mods.description: Adjusts VE quests generation to spawn closer to the player's base. A configuration menu is also available for customization.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Closer VE Quests

mods.name: Drug Policy Search
mods.description: Adds a search bar to the drug policy menu.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Drug Policy Search

mods.name: Research Icons
mods.description: Adds icons to all research projects.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Research Icons

mods.name: Emergency Gravship Launch
mods.description: Adds icons to all research projects.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Emergency Gravship Launch

mods.name: Cheat Menu
mods.description:
Cheat Menu adds a dedicated, searchable cheat tab with clear categories and one-click access to common debug-style actions.

This mod is also a framework: other mods can register their own cheats through the shared registry and integrate them directly into the same UI.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Cheat Menu

mods.name: Smart Ground Penetrating Scanner
mods.description: This mod adjusts the scanner's logic to prioritize open ground. While it doesn't strictly disable mountain spawns, it significantly nudges the algorithm to favor tiles without overhead mountains. If a valid reachable spot exists, your scanner is much more likely to find it.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Smart Ground Penetrating Scanner

mods.name: Assignments Override
mods.description:
Ever tried to manually order a pawn to do something… only to be told:
“Pawn is not assigned to this type of work.”

Even though you clearly want them to just do it?

This mod adds a simple, controlled way to override work restrictions for player-issued manual orders without breaking the pawn’s normal AI behavior.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Assignments Override

mods.name: RimMetrics
mods.description: RimMetrics is a lightweight telemetry and statistics framework for RimWorld. It tracks gameplay metrics for pawns and the colony, and surfaces them in a dedicated in‑game stats tab. It’s also built to be used as a dependency by other mods.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for RimMetrics

mods.name: Left Side Alerts
mods.description: Moves alerts to be rendered on the left side of the screen.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Left Side Alerts

mods.name: Declutter UI
mods.description: A lightweight utility mod designed to declutter Rimworld's UI.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Declutter UI

mods.name: Covered Ugly Thought Nullifier
mods.description: Nullifies the Ugly social thought when the target pawn is fully covered by a single apparel item (burka-like coverage).

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Covered Ugly Thought Nullifier

mods.name: Configurable Worksites
mods.description: Adds a mod settings menu that allows you to configure certain aspects of the worksite quest.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Configurable Worksites

mods.name: Inspired Unique
mods.description: Pawns can craft unique weapons when inspired with creativity.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Inspired Unique

mods.name: Mastercrafted Arms
mods.description: Allows level 20 crafters to craft unique weapons. Includes configurable chance, optional customization, and a minimum quality threshold.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Mastercrafted Arms

mods.name: VFE Props and Decor Search Bar Addon
mods.description: Adds a search bar to the categories props and decor menu.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for VFE Props and Decor Search Bar Addon

mods.name: Unassigned Beds Alert
mods.description: Displays an alert for colonists with unassigned beds.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Unassigned Beds Alert

mods.name: ProjectZomboid LevelUp Sound
mods.description: Plays the level up sound from Project Zomboid when a colonist levels up any skill.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for ProjectZomboid LevelUp Sound

mods.name: Share Settings
mods.description: Share your mod settings with anyone.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Share Settings

mods.name: Bug Off
mods.description: Insects will prefer defending their hives and won't attack your colony if another faction provokes them. This doesn't disable their colony assault behavior when all their hives are destroyed.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Bug Off

mods.name: Show DefName on Label - Continued
mods.description: Show definition's defName on its label.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Show DefName on Label - Continued

mods.name: Smart Weapon Trait
mods.description: Adds the Smart trait for unique weapons. This special trait guarantees a 100% hit chance, making every shot a bullseye. Works only for weapons that use bullet projectiles.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Smart Weapon Trait

mods.name: Infusion 2 - Continued
mods.description:
Infusions are like enchantments—they are applied randomly when an equipment is created, providing some stat bonuses or special effects like poison and vampiric healing. Based on the equipment's type and quality, they may get several infusions. (configurable)

Think infusions as prefixes and suffixes of procedural items, from hack and slash games, such as Diablo III or Pillars of Eternity.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Infusion 2 - Continued

mods.name: No Sympathy For Prisoners
mods.description: Pawns feel nothing about committing crimes against prisoners.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for No Sympathy For Prisoners

mods.name: Xenogerms Cost Neutroamine
mods.description: Adds a neutroamine requirement to xenogerm creation, scaling with gene complexity.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Xenogerms Cost Neutroamine

mods.name: Configurable Prison Breaks - Continued
mods.description: Allows prison breaks to be disabled completely or configured based on mental break threshold, default setting disables prison breaks when a pawn is happy (no mental break risk).

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Configurable Prison Breaks - Continued

mods.name: No Deep VCE Salt
mods.description: A patch to remove Vanilla Cooking Expanded salt from the deep drill resource pool.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for No Deep VCE Salt

mods.name: Construction Friendly Infestations
mods.description: Infestations will avoid spawning at buildings/furniture.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Construction Friendly Infestations

mods.name: Flanking Bonus
mods.description: Bonus damage and hit chance when attacking enemies from the side or back.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Flanking Bonus

mods.name: Weapon Mastery
mods.description: Adds a new simple weapon mastery mechanic into the game. Pawns use the same weapon for a decent amount of time, naturally they should start getting better at handling/using said weapon. This mod adds a new hidden skill that levels up as pawns use their weapons (similar to shooting/melee). Pawns will gradually receive some minor randomized bonuses from mastering weapons and will also rename their weapon for sentimental value.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Weapon Mastery

mods.name: No Ambient Ducking
mods.description: Prevents music from muting ambient sounds. Wind, biome ambience, and other subtle background sounds continue playing normally while music is active.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for No Ambient Ducking

mods.name: Bigger Devmode Buttons
mods.description: Modifies the Devmode menu action buttons to have a configurable wider width.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Bigger Devmode Buttons

mods.name: Limited Passions
mods.description: Limits newly generated humanlike pawns to one minor passion and one major passion.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Limited Passions

mods.name: Scenarios Menu Search
mods.description: Adds a search field to the scenario selection screen.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Scenarios Menu Search

mods.name: DeclutterUI UI Not Inlcuded Addon
mods.description: A UI Not Included add-on that adds a searchable "menus" main button, letting you find and open any main button (including ones you've hidden from the toolbars) without exposing UI Not Included's toolbar editor. This doesn't require DeclutterUI installed.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for DeclutterUI UI Not Inlcuded Addon

mods.name: Settlement Services
mods.description: Turns faction settlements into places that offer paid services instead of only trade and combat. Request medical care, training, hospitality, crafting commissions, and more; prices scale with your colony's wealth and the game's difficulty, and what's on offer depends on a settlement's faction, technology, and specialties.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Settlement Services

mods.name: Artisan Experience
mods.description: Rewards pawns with Artistic experience for finishing crafted or constructed items that contain art.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Artisan Experience

mods.name: Rim is Ready
mods.description: Plays a ding and/or sends a Discord notification once RimWorld finishes loading and reaches the main menu. Both notifications are configurable in the mod settings.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Rim is Ready

mods.name: Psylink Unbound
mods.description: Psylink Unbound raises the psylink level cap and makes each level reduce your psycasts' psyfocus cost, without changing vanilla's psyfocus bar itself. Both the cap and the discount per level are configurable, and the discount also applies to Vanilla Psycasts Expanded's psycasts if installed.

previewImage.alt: Preview artwork for Psylink Unbound
